title: Importing a Joomla site built from a quickstart keeps the one contract its params name: the slim package carries the version whose files the site serves, and a still-missing contract is named contract_unavailable
expect: S1: every test passes; a Tracy Business site under a 2 MB limit whose served template.css matches version 1.2.2 is sent a package under 2 MB holding exactly tracy-business/j6/1.2.2 and ends ok; a quickstart naming another contract keeps both; a site with no matching template keeps none; a contract still missing after the install ends install_failed with check contract_unavailable and its own sentence

selectors.host: tracy-add-site joomla.ts installCowork contractsToKeep, slim-package.ts contractCandidates probePaths pickContracts packageForImport

fence: An import never leaves a quickstart site's Claude Cowork without the contract its params name, and never sends a 2 MB host every version of a template
